mutations.kill_message_redacted: an EMPTY identified set is infeasibility, NEVER a detection
mutations.kill_rule: labeling an empty identified set a detection is rejected by the status-semantics validator

mutations.kill_message_redacted: a bounded (possibly broad) identified set is an uncertainty region, NEVER a central/point estimate
mutations.kill_rule: emitting a scalar central estimate for a broad (wide-interval) set is rejected by the set-valued-only guard

mutations.kill_message_redacted: solver nonconvergence is UNDETERMINED, NEVER a non-identification claim
mutations.kill_rule: mapping a solver nonconvergence to non_identification (instead of undetermined) is rejected by the status vocabulary guard

mutations.kill_message_redacted: cross-engine STATUS disagreement: exact 'bounded' vs numeric 'unbounded' — the downstream numerical claim is blocked
mutations.kill_rule: a fabricated status disagreement between the exact and numeric engines raises and blocks the claim

mutations.kill_message_redacted: artifact carries only a scalar summary and no set-valued fields — the identified set must be reported set-valued
mutations.kill_rule: an artifact carrying only a scalar summary and no set-valued fields is rejected by the artifact schema

mutations.kill_message_redacted: proposed lower bound on Omega_tilt (-1/10) is tighter than the pinned -3; the admissible box admissible_v1 is fixed before the fit and cannot be shrunk to an observed value
mutations.kill_rule: shrinking the admissible box to an observed point after seeing it is rejected by the pre-registered admissible-set pin
